note: Research snapshot of Australian work health and safety developments. Every item is a watch item, not an obligation; confirm each against its primary source at use time and record 'cannot be determined' where the source is unavailable. Items marked 'not verified at snapshot' were not confirmed at a primary source on the as-at date.

watch_items.item: Model Work Health and Safety Legislation Amendment (Incident Notification) 2025: adoption by each model WHS jurisdiction
watch_items.status_at_snapshot: Model WHS Act amended in December 2025 to add extended-absence, violent-incident and work-related suicide and attempted suicide notification duties and a duty to notify the holder of a corresponding duty; no jurisdiction's enactment confirmed at snapshot
watch_items.expected_trigger: Amending Bill introduced, passed or commenced in any model WHS jurisdiction

watch_items.item: Work Health and Safety Act 2011 (Cth) current compilation
watch_items.status_at_snapshot: Latest compilation C2024C00243 (1 July 2024), with s 30A industrial manslaughter in the table of contents
watch_items.expected_trigger: New compilation registered on the Federal Register of Legislation

watch_items.item: Industrial and workplace manslaughter offences in each jurisdiction
watch_items.status_at_snapshot: Not verified at snapshot for each jurisdiction. Commonwealth s 30A heading confirmed; a NSW Parliamentary Research Service paper of 19 January 2024 recorded six states and territories with such offences at that date. Confirm each jurisdiction's provision and commencement with its checker
watch_items.expected_trigger: Enactment, commencement or amendment of an offence in any jurisdiction, or a first prosecution outcome

watch_items.item: Occupational Health and Safety (Psychological Health) Regulations 2025 (Vic) and compliance code
watch_items.status_at_snapshot: Commenced 1 December 2025 according to the Premier of Victoria's release of that date; regulation text and compliance code version not verified at snapshot
watch_items.expected_trigger: Amendment of the regulations, a revised compliance code, or WorkSafe Victoria enforcement guidance

watch_items.item: Implementation of the model WHS laws, including Victoria
watch_items.status_at_snapshot: Safe Work Australia states that Victoria is the only jurisdiction that has not implemented the model WHS laws
watch_items.expected_trigger: Any Victorian move to adopt the model laws, or a jurisdiction departing from them

watch_items.item: Approved codes of practice on managing psychosocial hazards in each model WHS jurisdiction
watch_items.status_at_snapshot: Not verified at snapshot. Confirm each jurisdiction's approved code and its version at the regulator
watch_items.expected_trigger: Approval of a new or revised code in any jurisdiction

watch_items.item: Other amendments to the model WHS Act and Regulations
watch_items.status_at_snapshot: Tracked through Safe Work Australia's amendments page; amendments apply in a jurisdiction only once enacted there
watch_items.expected_trigger: Safe Work Australia publishes a further model-law amendment
